name: task
description: A backlog-to-branch task protocol: a human writes down what should happen, the agent plans it, implements it on a branch, and the human verifies and merges.

create_branch.title: Create a branch per task
create_branch.description: Whether a task may have its own branch. Off means every task is committed on main.

create_pull_request.title: Open a pull request
create_pull_request.description: Whether reaching in_review opens a pull request on GitHub, or a merge request on GitLab. Needs a branch.
